programme.title: Notranja lepota
programme.desc:
Sevda družbo reši iz pripora. Efsun sumi, da sta Emir in Sevda spet par. Emir Sevdo prepričuje, naj poskusi z zdravljenjem v okviru klinične študije.nnEfsun Sarpu pomaga pri pripravah na otvoritev restavracije. Tudi Serpil sumi, da hoče Sevda ponovno zapeljati Emirja, Sevda pa se medtem odloči za zdravljenje.
Efsun je mlada zdravnica iz manjšega kraja, ki ji je pomembna notranja lepota.
Emir je zdravnik iz Istanbula, ki pride do Efsun in ji pove, da prihaja v imenu njene mame.
Efsun z mamo, ki jo je že dolgo nazaj zapustila, sprva noče imeti nobenih opravkov.
Ko pa ji Emir pove, da mama umira, se skupaj z njim odpravi v Istanbul in izve, da ima mama uspešno lepotno kliniko. programme.title: Notranja lepota
programme.desc:
Cem in Burcu sta par, a Burcu noče, da to izve njegova mama. Hudo ji je, ker Cem zaradi nje ni naredil izpita, zaradi česar je njegov oče besen. Efsun zaposlenim pove, da ji je Pervin predala svoje delnice, in razglasi svoj načrt za kliniko. Vsi se vznemirijo, a jo Emir podpre. Hoče ji izpovedati ljubezen, a se ga začne Efsun izogibati, ko ji Sevda pove, da še vedno ljubi Emirja.
Efsun je mlada zdravnica iz manjšega kraja, ki ji je pomembna notranja lepota.
Emir je zdravnik iz Istanbula, ki pride do Efsun in ji pove, da prihaja v imenu njene mame.
Efsun z mamo, ki jo je že dolgo nazaj zapustila, sprva noče imeti nobenih opravkov.

programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Vida in Breda se pogovarjata o Slavku, Rok in Petra pa se pobotata. Sonja se izogiba pogovora o Ireni. Vida Mariji pove, kaj je izvedela od Irene.nnJože in Tomaž povabita Janeza na zaupen sestanek. Erik pove Janu, kakšen načrt je skoval za Italijo. Uroš pa razodene Andreju, kako je Erik grozil Bojanu. Mark in Irena se srečata na sprehodu.
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. Nejc Levstik, Jaka Šuligoj Lara Komar Tadej Pišek Marijana Brecelj Vo

programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.desc:
Zlatan in Vedrana odideta in vsi so potrti, še posebej Milica in Marko Šank. Zlatan se poslovi od Macanov in Stipana ter se dogovori z Vinkom, da ju bo odpeljal na letališče, vendar ga uščipne v križu in na koncu jima ponudi prevoz Martin. Tomi okleva glede odhoda v Kanado in nadaljevanja študija. Stipan od Zvoneta kupi zemljo, kar razjezi Janka, Stanislava in Oliverja. Na poti z letališča Martin pobere prikupno štoparko Megi, ki mu zakomplicira življenje.
V tretji sezoni bodo Zaglave doživele popoln pretres z novimi dogodki in zanimivimi preobrati.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Crni skuša izvedeti, kdo je Sanja in kaj ve o njem, a situacija uide izpod nadzora in Sanja pobegne iz gostilne. Ivana je jezna na Veljka, ker ji je prikril resnico o Tomu.nnVeljko in Joco sta znova v sporu z otroki. Petra in Lorena se vse bolj zbližujeta, medtem ko Klaudija in Damjan nadaljujeta s preiskovanjem Crnega.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. programme.title: Skrito v raju
programme.desc:
Mia je razočarana, ker jo Mark stalno postavlja na stranski tir. Da bi ga naredila ljubosumnega, se zateče k Žanu. Julija je globoko ganjena, da se je oče končno postavil zanjo. Vsa raznežena poljubi Davida. Referent z ministrstva obišče Bojana glede zanimive vloge Edvardovega vnuka. Leonova mama sprva odobri zemljišče za terapevtski vrtiček, nato pa se zaplete.
Slovenska serija Skrito v raju nas popelje v istrski kamp Paradiso, kjer si pisana bera dopustnikov polni baterije od vrveža glavnega mesta.
Glavna junaka sta Lara in Mark, ki se zaljubita na prvi pogled, a je pred njima še vrsta zapletov, ki so resen izziv za njuno zvezo. programme.title: Kmetija
programme.desc:
V hlevu vstanejo zarana in še v temi kopljejo luknjo za zemljanko. Tudi člani družine ne spijo dolgo, kajti nova naloga je zahtevna in morajo jo opraviti, sicer bodo tudi naslednji teden lačni.nnNa kmetijo pridrvi nov skrivnostni gost, ki je na kmetiji nekoč že bil. Nekaterim skrivnostni obiskovalec ni všeč.nnZaradi pomanjkanja hrane in razdelitve dela med prebivalci hleva izbruhne hud spor. Najbolj vroča tema dneva je dvoboj za imuniteto med izbranima hlapcem in deklo.
Pred nami je nova sezona priljubljenega šova Kmetija, v katerem je veliko dela in seveda tudi zabave.
Resničnostni šov Kmetija se vrača z 12. sezono. Med šestnajstimi tekmovalci so znani obrazi in obrazi, ki to še bodo.
Tekmovalci si hočejo z vsemi možnimi taktikami pridobiti prednost na poti do 50.000 evrov, pa jim Natalija Bratkovič s šokantnimi preobrati vedno znova zmeša štrene.

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Martin ima dobre novice za svojo pacientko Jano, ki ji pove, da je noseča. Toda namesto veselja jo preplavi strah. Zdravnik po prvih laboratorijskih izvidih ugotovi, da je Jana pred kratkim doživela spontani splav, zaradi česar se boji nove nosečnosti.nnTudi v zakonu z možem Maxom že dolgo ni vse v redu, kar dodatno otežuje situacijo. Ko se pojavijo resni zapleti, mora Jana v bolnišnico.
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. Tanja Roitzheim Hans Sigl Heiko Ruprecht Mark Keller Monika Baumgartner Ronja Forcher.

programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Yekta Ceylin pove, da jo bo odpeljal tja, kjer je bil umorjen njen oče. Trdi, da tam ne bo samo spoznala morilca, pač pa tudi ugotovila, da ji vsi njeni bližnji lažejo. Zgodba se nato vrne leto dni nazaj v čas, ko sta se Ceylin in Ilgaz prvič spoznala. Ogledali si bomo njun prvi skupni primer, ko najdejo umorjenega najstnika, Ceylin pa zastopa osumljenca.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Aranat Pinar Caglar Genctürk

Crni pokliče Petro, a Filipa izkoristi priložnost in mu razkrije, kje sta Petra in Lorena. Toma se znajde v hudi zagati zaradi Gabrijelinega prstana. Nika se sestane z Divno, ki ji je težko pri srcu zaradi njene zaroke s kriminalcem. Miro, Una in Jakov začnejo sodelovati z očeti, a Veljko kmalu povzroči težave.

programme.title: 24UR popoldne
programme.desc:
24UR popoldne je na programu vsak dan in poteka v živo iz osrednjega studia POP TV.
Oddaja na kratek, zgoščen in dinamičen način ponuja do takrat najaktualnejše novice dneva z različnih področij življenja: politike, gospodarstva, kronike, športa in vremensko napoved. Voditelji: Petra Kerčmar, Jani Muhič, Darja Zgonc in Edi Pucer.

programme.title: Sanjski moški Hrvaške
programme.desc:
Punce so zopet vedoželjne glede zmenkov s sanjskima moškima. Tokrat jih čaka skupinski zmenek, na katerem bodo morale pokazati svojo borbenost, požrtvovalnost in timski duh.nnPo ogrevanju so pripravljene za akcijo. Medtem se v vili ostale lotijo priprave navijaške točke. Na igrišču se razplamti prava borba. Bo na koncu slavil Karlov ali Petrov tim?
Pred nami je vznemirljiva romantična pustolovščina, polna čustev in ljubezenskih zapletov.
Vsaka ženska išče "tistega pravega". Je popolne športne postave, nestvarno belih zob, kakršne vidimo le v sanjah, in najlepšega nasmeha na svetu, nesramno čeden – on je "Gospod Popolni"!

programme.title: 24UR vreme
programme.desc:

Napoved je atraktivno podkrepljena z grafiko, ki ponuja nazoren pregled vremena po državi in z zanimivimi dogodki, povezanimi z vremenom. Prisluhnete lahko tudi nasvetom in vremenskim opozorilom, ki so postali stalnica pri očitnih klimatskih spremembah.

Poleg rednih rubrik najaktualnejše novice dneva zajemajo tudi vremensko napoved, družabno kroniko in šport.
Voditelji: Jani Muhič in Petra Kerčmar, Edi Pucer in Darja Zgonc.

programme.title: Kmetija
programme.desc:
V hišici na klancu prebiva skrivnostni obiskovalec, ki prinaša zlat in črn oreh, zato se nekateri še posebej trudijo okoli njega. Dobi najboljši zajtrk kar ga premorejo, kajti obiskovalcu s posebno močjo se ne gre zameriti.nnPo izboru prvega dvobojevalca se vzdušje začasno izboljša ob obisku tržnice, od koder zgolj z desetimi cekini prinesejo zajetno zalogo hrane. Zvečer na tajnem sestanku premlevajo možnosti za izbor drugega dvobojevalca in posledično oslabljen klan vplivnežev. Ali bo iz te moke nastal kruh?

programme.title: Gasilci v Chicagu
programme.desc:
Gasilci se odzovejo na požar v stanovanjski stavbi, kjer se borijo proti strupenim hlapom, Carver pa po intervenciji pristane v bolnišnici. Boden, Ritter, Herrmann in Kidd združijo moči, da bi razkrinkali lokalnega politika, odgovornega za kemični požar. Gallo je po nesreči svoje tete zaskrbljen glede njune prihodnosti.
Dogodivščine pogumnih gasilcev iz Chicaga.
Serija spremlja življenje gasilcev, reševalcev in policistov v velikem mestu. Prikazuje njihove vsakodnevne izzive: nevarne intervencije, reševanje življenj in soočanje z nepredvidljivimi nesrečami, hkrati pa raziskuje osebne zgodbe, odnose in konflikte med kolegi.
Med reševanjem drugih se liki spopadajo z lastnimi strahovi, izgubo, ljubeznijo in moralnimi odločitvami, kar ustvarja čustveno intenzivno pripoved, polno akcije, napetosti in človečnosti. programme.title: Mentalist: Črni helikopterji
programme.desc:
V Mehiki najdejo mrtvo ameriško tožilko Edith Furlach. Glede na to, da državne meje ni prečkala po uradni poti, Jane kmalu odkrije, da so jo umorili v Teksasu in njeno truplo prek podzemnega tunela prenesli v Mehiko. Rigsby in Van Peltova skušata medtem J.J.-ja LaRocha prepričati, da jima pomaga odkriti, kdo zalezuje bivše člane oddelka za umore.
Patrick Jane je neodvisni svetovalec pri kalifornijski policiji, ki s pomočjo svojega čuta za opazovanje in sklepanje reši še tako zapletene zločine.
Simon Baker (nominiranec za zlati globus), je Patrick Jane, neodvisni svetovalec Kalifornijskega preiskovalnega urada (CBI), ki ima osupljivo zgodovino reševanja resnih zločinov s pomočjo ostrega čuta za opazovanje.
Med sodelavci je Jane razvpit, ker ne upošteva protokola in je bil nekoč celo slaven kot jasnoviden medij, zdaj pa priznava, da je hlinil svoje sposobnosti. Drugi agenti zelo cenijo Janovo pomoč pri reševanju težkih in odmevnih primerov.
Višja agentka Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney)

programme.title: Mentalist: Siva voda
programme.desc:
Jane in Fischer preiskujeta umor, ki se je zgodil na ploščadi za črpanje nafte. Rigsby in Van Peltova medtem odpotujeta v Austin, kjer se ponovno pridružita svoji ekipi in z njihovo pomočjo še naprej iščeta napadalca, ki si je za tarče izbral bivše člane oddelka za umore.
Patrick Jane je neodvisni svetovalec pri kalifornijski policiji, ki s pomočjo svojega čuta za opazovanje in sklepanje reši še tako zapletene zločine.

programme.title: Notranja lepota
programme.desc:
Binnur in Efsun se napijeta v restavraciji. Binnur pokliče Emirja, ki ga zaskrbi in takoj pride ponju, da ju varno spravi domov. Efsun skrbi, kaj mu je povedala.nnPrepričati ga mora, da ima v resnici fanta, Binnur pa dodaja vedno nove laži. Serpil na skrivaj pripravlja velik dogodek. Zaposleni na kliniki niso zadovoljni z Efsuninimi spremembami.
Efsun je mlada zdravnica iz manjšega kraja, ki ji je pomembna notranja lepota.
Emir je zdravnik iz Istanbula, ki pride do Efsun in ji pove, da prihaja v imenu njene mame.
Efsun z mamo, ki jo je že dolgo nazaj zapustila, sprva noče imeti nobenih opravkov.
Ko pa ji Emir pove, da mama umira, se skupaj z njim odpravi v Istanbul in izve, da ima mama uspešno lepotno kliniko. Naj se še tako trudi, ostaja v slepi ulici, kajti na računu, ki ga je Yasar prinesel iz cvetličarne, piše, da je rože naročil on, Emir, kar pa seveda ni res.nnEmir postane prav obseden in ljubosumen tudi na svojega najboljšega prijatelja. programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Rok zagleda Marka in Ireno, ko se pogovarjata. Marija Ferdu razloži, da bi zaradi Markovega prihoda v Krko raje ostala doma. Uroš pove Janu, da je Erik izsiljeval Bojana za denar.nnIrena poskuša prepričati Roka, da je bilo srečanje z Markom zgolj naključje. Uroš pove Andreju, da je za pogin rib najverjetneje kriva Valentina. Mark se sooči z Ireno glede Emila.
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. Nejc Levstik, Jaka Šuligoj Lara Komar Tadej Piše

programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.title: Botri
programme.desc:
Macan Benz prejme denar iz projekta Evropske unije za polnilno postajo za električna vozila, zato Stanislav organizira dogodek za medije. Zaradi podpisa pogodbe mora Vinko ostati v Zaglavah, Jadranka pa se sama odpravi na slaščičarsko delavnico v Zagreb.nnMartin najde Josipov kombi in znova naleti na Megi, med njima pa preskočijo iskrice. Stanislav je šokiran, ko izve resnico o materinem grobu.
V tretji sezoni bodo Zaglave doživele popoln pretres z novimi dogodki in zanimivimi preobrati.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.
Ideja je zrasla na kanadskem zelniku bogatega izseljenca Stanislava Stanleyja Cukela, ki se je odločil vrniti in vnesti duh svetovljanstva in turizma v svoj rojstni kraj. Kmalu mu z zlomljenim srcem sledi

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Crni pokliče Petro, a Filipa izkoristi priložnost in mu razkrije, kje sta Petra in Lorena. Toma se znajde v hudi zagati zaradi Gabrijelinega prstana. Nika se sestane z Divno, ki ji je težko pri srcu zaradi njene zaroke s kriminalcem. Miro, Una in Jakov začnejo sodelovati z očeti, a Veljko kmalu povzroči težave.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. programme.title: Skrito v raju
programme.desc:
Lara si očita, ker je pozabila na obletnico očetove smrti. Julija, David in Edvard se bodo kot ekipa spravili na Bojana, Julija v ta namen z računa klinike dvigne denar.nnMark je razočaran zaradi projekta, ko mamo sooči glede dviga denarja, pa se še Edi postavi Juliji v bran. Po enem letu se srečata David in Nada, Bojan pa želi, da Julija plača za svoja dejanja.
Slovenska serija Skrito v raju nas popelje v istrski kamp Paradiso, kjer si pisana bera dopustnikov polni baterije od vrveža glavnega mesta.
Glavna junaka sta Lara in Mark, ki se zaljubita na prvi pogled, a je pred njima še vrsta zapletov, ki so resen izziv za njuno zvezo. programme.title: Kmetija
programme.desc:
V hišici na klancu prebiva skrivnostni obiskovalec, ki prinaša zlat in črn oreh, zato se nekateri še posebej trudijo okoli njega. Dobi najboljši zajtrk kar ga premorejo, kajti obiskovalcu s posebno močjo se ne gre zameriti.nnPo izboru prvega dvobojevalca se vzdušje začasno izboljša ob obisku tržnice, od koder zgolj z desetimi cekini prinesejo zajetno zalogo hrane. Zvečer na tajnem sestanku premlevajo možnosti za izbor drugega dvobojevalca in posledično oslabljen klan vplivnežev. Ali bo iz te moke nastal kruh?
Pred nami je nova sezona priljubljenega šova Kmetija, v katerem je veliko dela in seveda tudi zabave.
Resničnostni šov Kmetija se vrača z 12. sezono. Med šestnajstimi tekmovalci so znani obrazi in obrazi, ki to še bodo.
Tekmovalci si hočejo z vsemi možnimi taktikami pridobiti prednost na poti do 50.000 evrov, pa jim Natalija Bratkovič s šokantnimi preobrati vedno znova zmeša štrene.

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Dr. Gruber se posveča noseči pacientki Jani, ko Josie nenadoma doživi odpoved ledvic. Karin zahteva, da Martin ne sodeluje več pri zdravljenju njene hčerke, saj se boji, da bi mu v primeru najhujšega pripisala krivdo.nnMartin spoštuje njeno odločitev, a ne more mirno opazovati, kako se Josiejino stanje slabša. Medtem Sophia preseneti družino z novim fantom, a prihod njegove matere razkrije nepričakovano povezavo.
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Yekta se odpravi na večerjo z Bulentom. Medtem ko je Ilgaz z morilskim orožjem na poti na policijo, ga ugrabita Nevzat in njegov pajdaš. Ceylin, Eren, Efe in Iclal kmalu ugotovijo, da se je Ilgazu nekaj zgodilo, zato ga začnejo iskati. Parla gre na zmenek s Canberkom.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Aranat Pinar Caglar Genctürk Onur Özaydin Beren Nur Karadis Zeynep Atilgan Ugur Polat.

Miro in Jakov začasno zakopljeta bojno sekiro. Petra in Lorena bežita pred Crnim, ki jima je za petami, a Loreni postane slabo, zato jo Petra odpelje v bolnišnico.nnJakova skrbi za Loreno, medtem ko Miro preživlja večer z Uno ob Nikini slabi kuhinji. programme.title: Sanjski moški Hrvaške
programme.desc:
Dekleta se pripravljajo na glamurozni koktajl večer. Ena od tekmovalk resno razmišlja, da bi prestopila v Petrov tim. Sanjska moška skušata svoje izbranke bolje spoznati, medtem ko se one borijo za njuno pozornost.nnKo Karlo in Petar podelita zadnje rdeče vrtnice, napetost doseže vrhunec. Sledi šok: kateri dve dekleti bosta prejeli divjo vrtnico in z njo posebno moč?
Pred nami je vznemirljiva romantična pustolovščina, polna čustev in ljubezenskih zapletov.
Vsaka ženska išče "tistega pravega". Je popolne športne postave, nestvarno belih zob, kakršne vidimo le v sanjah, in najlepšega nasmeha na svetu, nesramno čeden – on je "Gospod Popolni"!

programme.desc:
Kiddova na intervenciji vzpostavi vez z brezdomcem, a ta napačno razume njeno prijaznost, kar vodi do fizičnega obračuna s Carverjem in njegove aretacije. Kylie uspešno opravi gasilski izpit, Herrmann pa se po Cindyjini bitki z rakom trudi postati boljši človek. Brettova se znajde pod pritiskom po zahtevnem klicu, ki jo močno prizadene.
Dogodivščine pogumnih gasilcev iz Chicaga.
Serija spremlja življenje gasilcev, reševalcev in policistov v velikem mestu. Prikazuje njihove vsakodnevne izzive: nevarne intervencije, reševanje življenj in soočanje z nepredvidljivimi nesrečami, hkrati pa raziskuje osebne zgodbe, odnose in konflikte med kolegi.
Med reševanjem drugih se liki spopadajo z lastnimi strahovi, izgubo, ljubeznijo in moralnimi odločitvami, kar ustvarja čustveno intenzivno pripoved, polno akcije, napetosti in človečnosti. Lisa Campbell Taylor Kinney Christian Stolte Joe Minoso Kara Killmer Robyn Coffin David Eigenberg Miranda Rae Mayo Katelynn Shennett Alberto Rosende Daniel Kyri

Tokrat mora Jane pomagati svoji kolegici Grace, ki jo nekdo ugrabi v njeni hotelski sobi. Grace medtem uspešno pobegne iz koče, v katero jo je zaprl Haibach, a kaj, ko jo Haibachova sestra Hazel hitro najde.

programme.title: Mentalist: Vijolice
programme.desc:
Med ropom umetniške galerije roparji ubijejo Johna Hannigana, zato se Patrick ponudi, da bo FBI-jevemu oddelku za zločine s področja umetnosti pomagal ujeti smrtonosne roparje. Z Lisbonovo se začneta izdajati za premožni par, ki krade umetnine, in na ta način tatove privabita v svoje domovanje, kjer naj bi se nahajale ukradene umetnine. Agent Marcus Pike medtem Lisbonvo povabi na zmenek.

programme.desc: The '67 Jeepster is back, as Stacey goes underneath and deals with the saggy suspension, faded brakes and oh-so-many leaks. It's all part of a continuing level-1 restoration, and well within the scope of what most people can do in their own garage.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey visits the Lions Automobilia Museum to tell the story of the iconic Lions Drag Strip, home to hot-rodders and drag racers from 1955 to 1972; he turns back the clock to a time when a guy could swap a cam and a carb, then show up ready to race.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey uses his old Lil' Red Wagon Dodge to show how to stop the deterioration cycle that sets in when a vehicle sits for an extended period of time; he shows how to look past the faded paint and flat tires to focus on things that matter.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: To pay tribute to the early hot rod spirit, Stacey rolls in a 1940 Chevy coupe and puts together a hot small block to go in it; multiple carbs, finned aluminum and plenty of horsepower are just some of the magic ingredients that make this rod roar.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: The Little Red Wagon is back on the chopping block, as Stacey continues upgrading the interior of this well-worn '99 Dodge truck; he adds new carpet and headliner, repaints the door panels and changes the interior color, all on a reasonable budget.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: When laying out a hot rod build, a lot of people make the mistake of overlooking the chassis and frame; Stacey digs into a full frame replacement to make sure a 1940 Chevy can handle everything he's going to throw at it.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey proves that not all toolboxes are created equal with Cornwell's new ARCA series, then checks out a record-breaking '63 'Vette with a Cummins diesel; he digs into barn finds, picks accessories and exhaust for the '40 Chevy hot rod, and more.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey visits a father-and-son team who are literally upside down in their restoration of an old C10 pickup; back in the garage, Stacey shows the importance of a compressed air system for tools.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: In the start of Project Red Bird, Stacey digs into a well-worn '98 Trans Am to see if he can't unlock its hidden potential on a reasonable budget.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the rear suspension of the LS-powered '98 Trans Am to show how upgrading each component can improve handling.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: With the front and rear suspensions beefed up on project Red Bird, the '98 Trans Am should be ready to fly; Stacey has a few more upgrades that need to be addressed.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey takes three Cornwell toolboxes and turns them into drivable vehicles by pulling parts from junk yards, Craigslist and Facebook Marketplace.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Now that the old Bird's suspension is beefed up, Stacey has to make sure it's going to stop, so he outfits it with some massive Baer brakes.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in what could be the ultimate open-air fun machine, an original Meyers Manx dune buggy; these crazy, colorful, fiberglass-bodied buggies were not only beyond cool, they also started a revolution of affordable do-it-yourself projects.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ
programme.desc: There was a time when vans ruled the custom scene; like lightning from a wizard's wand, they disappeared; vans are back, and Stacey has a few tricks up his sleeve to turn that dumpy old phone service or laundry van into a sweet street machine.

programme.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: SEC Now

programme.title: Franklin and Friends
programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

programme.title: Franklin
programme.desc: Six-year-old Franklin the turtle, his best friend Bear, and their pals face life's challenges together in this animated series based on the books by Paulette Bourgeois and Brenda Clark. Franklin and his friends learn about life in their village of Woodland, frequently with the help of a parent or other adult.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Marine biologist Danni Washington hosts this series that explains how nature has helped to inspire technology that people use on a daily basis. Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

programme.title: The Carol Burnett Show
programme.desc: Comedian and stage actress Carol Burnett, who first gained popularity during her stint on "The Gary Moore Show," hosted this one-hour variety series. Her talented supporting players included Harvey Korman, Tim Conway, Vicki Lawrence (who got the job based on her resemblance to Burnett) and Lyle Waggoner. Skits often featured guest stars, such as Mama Cass of the Mamas and the Papas or singer Steve Lawrence. One sketch, "The Family" (which featured Lawrence as the persnickety Mama and Burnett as her hotheaded daughter) was later spun-off into it's own sitcom.

programme.title: The Best of The Carol Burnett Show
programme.desc: Featuring the original broadcast master collection of Carol's song-and-dance spoofs of TV or movie classics, including Hollywood guests like Steve Martin.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

programme.title: The Longest Yard
programme.desc: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A veteran criminal planning a major bank robbery, Buck (Robert Patrick) assembles a team to pull off the heist. When the fugitive Luther (Duane Whitaker) travels to meet the crew in Mexico, he unexpectedly ends up near a bar in the middle of the desert and gets turned into a vampire by one of the establishment's fang-sporting regulars. Before long, Luther joins his fellow felons at the bank, but his newfound blood-sucking ways result in plenty of fierce human and vampire conflict.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: An executioner's daughter joins an outlaw, who escaped death, in a journey that leads to vampires.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: Blue Eyed Girl
programme.desc: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Blue Story
programme.desc: Best friends Timmy and Marco go to the same high school in Peckham but live in neighboring London boroughs. When Marco gets beaten up by one of Timmy's primary school friends, the two boys wind up on rival sides of a never-ending cycle of gang wars in which there are no winners, only hapless victims.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: In this adaptation of Jane Austen's classic novel, pretty socialite Emma Woodhouse (Gwyneth Paltrow) entertains herself by playing matchmaker for those around her. Her latest "project" is Harriet Smith, an unpretentious debutant, while Emma herself receives the attentions of the dashing Frank Churchill (Ewan McGregor). However, Emma's attempts at matchmaking cause more problems than solutions and may ultimately jeopardize her own chance at love and happiness.

programme.title: Cold Mountain
programme.desc: In this classic story of love and devotion set against the backdrop of the American Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier named W.P. Inman (Jude Law) deserts his unit and travels across the South, aiming to return to his young wife, Ada (Nicole Kidman), who he left behind to tend their farm. As Inman makes his perilous journey home, Ada struggles to keep their home intact with the assistance of Ruby (Renée Zellweger), a mysterious drifter sent to help her by a kindly neighbor.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: If You Lust Me
programme.desc: A young woman puts the age-old adage of love at first sight to the test when a stranger professes his undying devotion. But is he sincere or is it just another con by some hustler trying to get her in bed? She decides to give him a test... of sorts..

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: An accident connects four groups of people on three different continents: two young Moroccan goatherds, a vacationing American couple (Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett), a deaf Japanese teen and her father, and a Mexican nanny who takes her young charges across a border without parental permission.

programme.title: The Road
programme.desc: America is a grim, gray shadow of itself after a catastrophe. A man (Viggo Mortensen) and his young son (Kodi Smit-McPhee) wander through this post-apocalyptic world, trying to keep the dream of civilization alive. They journey toward the sea, surviving as best they can on what they can scavenge, and try to avoid roving gangs of savage humans who will turn them into slaves, or worse.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright).

programme.title: Breathe
programme.desc: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: The Edge of Seventeen
programme.desc: Everyone knows that growing up is hard, and life is no easier for high school junior Nadine (Hailee Steinfeld), who is already at peak awkwardness when her all-star older brother Darian (Blake Jenner) starts dating her best friend Krista (Haley Lu Richardson). All at once, Nadine feels more alone than ever, until an unexpected friendship with a thoughtful teen (Hayden Szeto) gives her a glimmer of hope that things just might not be so terrible after all.

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright).

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Deadlock
programme.desc: Wanted criminal Ron Whitlock leads a rogue team of mercenaries on a mission of vengeance. Convinced that the government is working against them, the merciless group brutally seizes an energy plant and holds everyone inside hostage. With a nearby town on the brink of massive flooding and destruction, it's up to a retired Army ranger to save thousands of innocent lives before it's too late.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: The Painter
programme.desc: An ex-CIA operative is tracked down by a young woman and they become entangled in an unauthorized black ops program.

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

programme.title: The Hurricane
programme.desc: Denzel Washington is Rubin "Hurricane" Carter, a man whose dreams of winning the middleweight boxing title were destroyed when he was arrested along with another man for the murders of 3 people in a New Jersey bar. Wrongfully accused, Carter and John Artis were sentenced to 3 life terms in prison.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape (Johnny Depp) is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother (Darlene Cates), who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie (Leonardo DiCaprio), who has a knack for finding trouble. Settled into a job at a grocery store and an ongoing affair with local woman Betty Carver (Mary Steenburgen), Gilbert finally has his life shaken up by the free-spirited Becky (Juliette Lewis).

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York.

programme.title: Fences
programme.desc: Troy Maxson makes his living as a sanitation worker in the 1950s Pittsburgh. Maxson once dreamed of becoming a professional baseball player, but was deemed too old when the major leagues began admitting black athletes. Bitter over his missed opportunity, Troy creates further tension in his family when he squashes his son's chance to meet a college football recruiter.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

programme.title: The Hurricane
programme.desc: Denzel Washington is Rubin "Hurricane" Carter, a man whose dreams of winning the middleweight boxing title were destroyed when he was arrested along with another man for the murders of 3 people in a New Jersey bar. Wrongfully accused, Carter and John Artis were sentenced to 3 life terms in prison.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: Frank Serpico is an idealistic New York City cop who refuses to take bribes, unlike the rest of the force. His actions get Frank shunned by the other officers, and often placed in dangerous situations by his partners. When his superiors ignore Frank's accusations of corruption, he decides to go public with the allegations. Although this causes the Knapp Commission to investigate his claims, Frank has also placed a target on himself. The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Frank (Leonardo DiCaprio) and April Wheeler (Kate Winslet) always see themselves as far-removed from the conventionality of suburbia. Yet that is exactly what creeps up on them when they buy a house in Connecticut. He toils 10 hours a day in a job he hates, while she, as a 1950s homemaker, yearns for fulfillment and passion. Rebelling against the torpor of their lives, the couple plan an escape that may push them to their limits.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Patriots Day
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes on April 15, 2013, when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon. In the aftermath of the attack, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders (Mark Wahlberg), FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers (Kevin Bacon) and Commissioner Ed Davis (John Goodman) join courageous survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the suspects and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Queen & Slim
programme.desc: Slim and Queen's first date takes an unexpected turn when a policeman pulls them over for a minor traffic violation. When the situation escalates, Slim takes the officer's gun and shoots him in self-defense. Now labeled cop killers in the media, Slim and Queen feel that they have no choice but to go on the run and evade the law. When a video of the incident goes viral, the unwitting outlaws soon become a symbol of trauma, terror, grief and pain for people all across the country.

programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known.

programme.title: The Road
programme.desc: America is a grim, gray shadow of itself after a catastrophe. A man (Viggo Mortensen) and his young son (Kodi Smit-McPhee) wander through this post-apocalyptic world, trying to keep the dream of civilization alive. They journey toward the sea, surviving as best they can on what they can scavenge, and try to avoid roving gangs of savage humans who will turn them into slaves, or worse.

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Deadlock
programme.desc: Wanted criminal Ron Whitlock leads a rogue team of mercenaries on a mission of vengeance. Convinced that the government is working against them, the merciless group brutally seizes an energy plant and holds everyone inside hostage. With a nearby town on the brink of massive flooding and destruction, it's up to a retired Army ranger to save thousands of innocent lives before it's too late.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman (Johnny Knoxville) and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy (Jackson Nicoll), set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt.

programme.title: Pelé: Birth of a Legend
programme.desc: Under guidance from manager Vicente Feola (Vincent D'Onofrio), young Pelé (Kevin de Paula) utilizes his street soccer skills to lead Brazil to the World Cup in 1958.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Conor (Keanu Reeves) is a ticket scalper, gambler and, now, Little League coach for a rag-tag team of kids in one of the toughest part of Chicago. He's no role model, but his buddy Jimmy won't help him pay off his gambling debts unless Conor coaches Jimmy's corporately sponsored team. Surprising even himself, Conor becomes attached to his players -- and to their attractive schoolteacher (Diane Lane) -- and drawn into their tough and sometimes tragic lives.

programme.title: Loosies
programme.desc: A young pickpocket in the New York subways who is living a fast and free lifestyle is confronted by a woman with whom he had a one-night stand. She informs him that she is now pregnant with his child. He must now make a choice.

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: The Longest War
programme.desc: The human stories and drama behind America's involvement in Afghanistan, now the longest war in U.S. history; features interviews with intelligence operatives, soldiers, families, Afghan officials, journalists, and government and military officials.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Salvation
programme.desc: After shooting the man who murdered his wife, a Danish settler (Mads Mikkelsen) incurs the wrath of the man's brother (Jeffrey Dean Morgan), a ruthless land baron who rules their frontier town.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: Dante (Brian O'Halloran) is called in to cover a shift at his New Jersey convenience store on his day off. His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer).

programme.title: Good Kill
programme.desc: An Air Force drone pilot (Ethan Hawke) begins to question the ethics of dropping bombs on Afghanistan from the safety of his post in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Seven Five
programme.desc: Former NYPD officer Michael Dowd tells how he and his partner committed a long list of crimes, including running their own cocaine ring, while on the job in the 1980s and early '90s.

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Morris Buttermaker is a burned-out minor league baseball player who loves to drink and can't keep his hands to himself. His long-suffering lawyer arranges for him to manage a local Little League team, and Buttermaker soon finds himself the head of a rag-tag group of misfit players. Through unconventional team-building exercises and his offbeat coaching style, Buttermaker helps his hapless Bears prepare to meet their rivals, the Yankees.

programme.title: Ashby
programme.desc: After moving to a new town with his single mother (Sarah Silverman), a teen (Nat Wolff) befriends a retired CIA assassin (Mickey Rourke) who teaches him valuable life lessons.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Eagle vs. Shark
programme.desc: Lily (Loren Horsley), a socially awkward fast-food waitress, meets Jarrod (Jemaine Clement), an equally oddball video-game clerk, at a costume party. She flips over him, even though he is not exactly the nicest guy around, and the pair begin a strange relationship. Gearing up for his ultimate revenge against a high-school bully, Jarrod dumps Lily, but she digs her heels in and refuses to give up the fight.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

programme.title: Blue Story
programme.desc: Best friends Timmy and Marco go to the same high school in Peckham but live in neighboring London boroughs. When Marco gets beaten up by one of Timmy's primary school friends, the two boys wind up on rival sides of a never-ending cycle of gang wars in which there are no winners, only hapless victims.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way.

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: Lester Burnham (Kevin Spacey) is a gainfully employed suburban husband and father. Fed up with his boring, stagnant existence, he quits his job and decides to reinvent himself as a pot-smoking, responsibility-shirking teenager. What follows is at once cynical, hysterical, and, eventually, tragically uplifting.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

programme.title: Boys and Girls
programme.desc: Ryan and Jennifer are opposites who definitely do not attract. At least that's what they always believed. When they met as twelve-year-olds, they disliked one another. When they met again as teenagers, they loathed each other. But when they meet in college, the uptight Ryan and the free-spirited Jennifer find that their differences bind them together and a rare friendship develops.

programme.title: Seaside
programme.desc: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house.

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt.

programme.title: Blue Eyed Girl
programme.desc: Summoned home to visit her two sisters and her ailing father, a woman starts to re-evaluate her life as she wonders what could have been.

programme.title: Before Dawn
programme.desc: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind.

programme.title: The Free World
programme.desc: Released from prison for a crime he didn't commit, a man (Boyd Holbrook) goes on the run with a woman (Elisabeth Moss) who's suspected of killing her abusive husband.

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces.

programme.title: I See You
programme.desc: Strange occurrences plague a small-town detective and his family as he investigates the disappearance of a boy.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

programme.title: Death Without Mercy
programme.desc: On 6 February, 2023, a 7.8 earthquake hits a large area of Turkey and Syria. The shock of the it soon gives way to a record of human failure. Two Syrian families, over the course of ten days, they desperately try to find their loved ones.

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop.

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system.

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: Though adored by the people, the Duchess of Devonshire (Keira Knightley) is not content to sit as a pretty figurehead. Determined to be a major player in affairs of state, she rises to the forefront of the Whig Party and helps usher in reform in late-1700s England. The one thing it seems she cannot do is win the heart of her husband (Ralph Fiennes).

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Matt Sullivan's (Josh Hartnett) last big relationship ended in disaster and ever since his heart's been aching and his commitment's been lacking. Then came Lent, that time of year when everybody gives something up. That's when Matt decides to go where no man's gone before and make a vow: No sex. Whatsoever. For 40 straight days. At first he has everything under control. That is until the woman of his dreams, Erica (Shannyn Sossamon), walks into his life.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: When a turboprop stalls and crashes into a North Carolina forest, investigators resort to a risky test flight-and uncover an industry-wide safety problem.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: A plane with members of the Manchester United football team crashes while heading home from Yugoslavia, killing 23 aboard.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: On 28 December 1978, the crew of United Airlines Flight 173 are preoccupied with a landing gear problem as the aircraft circles in a holding pattern in the vicinity of Portland, Oregon; it runs out of fuel and crashes in a sparsely populated area.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: Colgan Air 9446 nosedives into the waters off Cape Cod just minutes after takeoff following a four-day maintenance stop.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: When John F. Kennedy Jr.'s Piper Saratoga crashed in 1999, the NTSB faces big pressure to find the wreckage and the cause.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: Relying on instinct rather than the rule book, three flights end in tragedy when crews improvise on their final approach.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: A passenger ferry sinks after crashing into rocks off the coast of a Greek island, killing 82; it leads to a shocking investigation.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: While landing at a notoriously tricky Alaskan island airport, the pilots of a twin turboprop can't stop their plane.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: When an American cargo plane crashes moments after takeoff, investigators uncover a systemic problem with aircraft maintenance.

programme.title: Air Disasters
programme.desc: A Boeing 767 crashes miles from a South Korean runway; the investigation leads to contradicting stories between the surviving pilot and air traffic control.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: Take a cruise where the guests choose the ports to visit and the captain and crew work overtime to make it happen.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: The only cruise ship designed specifically to navigate the treasures and dangers at the southern tip of South America.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: Cruise among the icebergs of Greenland and the Canadian High Arctic aboard the expedition cruiser Ocean Endeavour.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: The Sky Princess carries passengers from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, to three Central American stops.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: The world's latest, most-advanced expedition cruise ship Roald Amundsen whisks passengers on an adventurous voyage to Antarctica.

programme.title: Mighty Cruise Ships
programme.desc: Costa Diadema's seven-day cruise around the Mediterranean offers Italian delights to its passengers and challenges to its captain and crew.

programme.title: Mighty Trains
programme.desc: Passengers are treated like royalty on Indian Railways' Maharaja's Express.

programme.title: Mighty Trains
programme.desc: The prairies of Canada; the deserts of Australia; the cold of the Norwegian Arctic Circle; the steepest slopes of the mighty Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Mighty Trains
programme.desc: A trip aboard one of the world's most expensive and sought-after train rides details the journey for both passengers and crew.

programme.title: Mighty Ships
programme.desc: The Norwegian Breakaway cruise ship sets sail on her first voyage, and her captain faces a tough decision when a North Atlantic tempest forms.

programme.title: Mighty Ships

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: An oilman (Albert Dekker) and a cowboy (John Wayne) become boom-town rivals for a schoolmarm (Martha Scott) and Oklahoma oil.

programme.desc: A framed Texas rancher (Robert Knapp) escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).

programme.title: Places in the Heart
programme.desc: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spaulding (Sally Field) struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret (Lindsay Crouse) ; a blind boarder, Mr. Will (John Malkovich) ; and a would-be thief, Moze (Danny Glover), who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton.

programme.title: The Outlaw Stallion
programme.desc: A boy and his mother are kidnapped by outlaws after the boy's stallion kills the outlaw leader's mount.

programme.title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
programme.desc: When brash Texas border officer Mike Norton wrongfully kills and buries the friend and ranch hand of Pete Perkins, the latter is reminded of a promise he made to bury his friend, Melquiades Estrada, in his Mexican home town. He kidnaps Norton and exhumes Estrada's corpse and the odd caravan sets out on horseback for Mexico. As Estrada's body begins to rot, Norton begins to unravel, but Perkins remains determined to honor his vow.

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Two siblings (Gabriel Casseus, Antwon Tanner) and their team of gunmen try to rob a corrupt moneyman's (David Carradine) bank.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: Ian Mitchell is thrust into a deadly game after a mysterious wooden box appears on his doorstep; it contains a photo of a stranger and a loaded gun with instructions to kill.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: Lawyer Ian Mitchell is brought into a deadly game when he receives a box that contains a gun and a picture of a stranger. Along with those items, the box includes instructions for Mitchell to kill the pictured individual. After being attacked by another stranger, Mitchell discovers he has been chosen to take part in the lethal contest by a mysterious organization known as The Watchers, a group he must outwit in order to survive and have any chance to return to his previously normal life with his family.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: A near-death encounter with another hunter leads Ian to discover that The Watchers who steer the game are intractable.

programme.title: Dragon Wars
programme.desc: In an antique shop, light from an old chest strikes young Ethan (Jason Behr). Amazed, owner Jack (Robert Forster) tells Ethan he now carries the spirit of a warrior who battled dragons in 16th-century Korea -- and one day he'll find a tattooed girl carrying the spirit of that warrior's beloved. Years later Ethan is working as a reporter when he meets tattooed Sarah (Amanda Brooks). Soon after, dragons descend on Los Angeles seeking out the two souls of the ancient lovers.

programme.title: Urban Justice
programme.desc: A former government agent (Steven Seagal) begins a relentless pursuit of his son's (Cory Hart) murderer.

programme.title: Nothing but the Truth
programme.desc: When reporter Rachel Armstrong (Kate Beckinsale) writes a story that reveals the identity of a covert CIA operative, the government demands that Rachel reveal her source. She defies the special prosecutor (Matt Dillon) and is thrown in jail. Meanwhile, her attorney, Albert Burnside (Alan Alda) argues her case all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

programme.title: Pistol Whipped
programme.desc: Former police officer Matt Conlin hits rock bottom. His drinking is out of control, and he has huge gambling debts. Just as Matt is about to give up all hope, an enigmatic old man approaches him with a proposition. The old man will pay off Matt's gambling debts if he agrees to assassinate the city's top gangsters. Though Matt is reluctant, he accepts the old man's mission, but soon realizes it isn't as straightforward as it seems.

programme.title: Ticking Clock
programme.desc: An investigative reporter (Cuba Gooding Jr.) finds the journal of a serial killer and traces it back to a 9-year-old orphan.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope.

programme.desc: The most memorable moments from movie history are ranked in this funny and exciting show with anecdotes from experts that will make you laugh and take you back to the most iconic, outrageous, and unforgettable movie moments ever.
